placements.why: The content describes a mandatory onboarding procedure — an organizational process for integrating new hires — requiring a top-level organizational category that nothing existing covers.
placements.title: How people and processes are structured to integrate new members
placements.frame: What organizational practices and procedures govern how work is done and who is brought into it?

placements.title: From wiki page to mandated first-week checklist
placements.frame: How has onboarding been standardized into a mandatory procedure, and what did it replace?
placements.why: Both segments describe the Pallasine checklist as a universal, mandatory onboarding procedure covering accounts, pairing rotation, and a shadow shift in the first week, and note it superseded the old wiki page last quarter. This is a thematic subject — how onboarding is standardized — that future envelopes about onboarding practices will continue to feed, not a one-time fact.
